entries.2a24706e12c1a77e: The company recruits franchisees; sells food ingredients such as noodles and soup as well as consumables to franchisees; provides management guidance; designs and manages the construction of store interiors; sells kitchen equipment; and produces and sells printed materials, among other activities. entries.884a0412c163d2fb: The company is headquartered in Kōriyama, Fukushima Prefecture, and operates a restaurant business through a chain of ramen shops. In October 2024, it absorbed its wholly owned subsidiary KOURAKUEN CORPORATION through an absorption merger and became an operating company; it has no consolidated subsidiaries. As of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 581, and the company is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
